review_description: Best in the business, I have used Callum & the team for 3 different jobs and they have always been fantastic. Best communication I have ever experienced in the building/trade industry. I will never use anyone else!

We previously used another company to install solar on our home and were happy until we had to remove our solar panels and realised they’d done a poor install job and damaged our roof tiles. We had to pay someone to install the right cable.When we decided to install solar at our commercial property we spoke to 3 companies and chose Five Star Electrical. Very happy with the service, product and workmanship. Would have no problem recommending to anyone.

Would recommend Five Island Electrical to anyone, from the initial quote to the final product they were super helpful along the way and answered any questions I had and were always happy to help. My electricity bill has gone down significantly.
Getting solar was such an easy process from start to finish with Callum. He was efficient and professional. Would highly recommend.
